{{Top|canon=Expedition to Malachor}}
The '''Wolhanian expedition''' was an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] mission to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] that took place [[Time/Legends|sometime]] by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Raygar]] was a member of the expedition. At some point afterward, Raygar became obsessed with locating mystical artifacts and lost respect in the [[Academician|academic]] community.<ref name="DSPL">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>

==History==
The group uncovered a [[Darth Sidious' Sith Chalice/Legends|Sith Chalice]]. The chalice became part of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] private art collection at some point by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="CL" />
